scope: Offline calculation of existing snapshot only; no Chrome or shared-account access. Public web-source version checks separately in SERP-NOTES.md.

calculationPolicy.seriesSelection: Longest table with at least 26 rows including header; queryVerified/status checked; drop last data row conservatively.
calculationPolicy.first8: Mean of first 8 complete rows; no conversion using gpts.
calculationPolicy.last12Slope: Ordinary least squares of last 12 indices against 0..11, index points/week.
calculationPolicy.lowResolution: maxIndex<=3 OR last8Mean<2 OR nonZeroPoints<12. Chosen audit heuristic, not Google rule.
calculationPolicy.classification: Transparent analyst heuristic only: recent growth/recovery + positive slope=>rising; positive slope/8-week improvement but last4 weakening=>rising with pullback; consistent negative=>declining; else stable/mixed.
calculationPolicy.certainty: No high certainty from this offline calculation alone. Game-intent attribution, seasonality, same-term source validation and actual Google SERP remain separate.
